answer: Streak multipliers: each identity's weight is its consecutive-day streak, capped at 30. Sybils splitting into n fresh identities start at weight 1, so they need 30n days to match one honest 30-day streak. A daily "pigment" check — each identity must submit a uniquely-colored hash — makes clones detectable. Honest miners hold the reef of long streaks; attackers wash out at the dawn of each reset. Cost scales linearly with identities while influence stays flat, so farming never beats one persistent miner.
